lambda_samples: 10 extreme + core pairs; 6 extreme lambdas for swap tests

A.name: A: Closure-Separation Swap
A.note: Definitively NOT a symmetry (frac_asym=0.833). Near-sym cases near lambda_cl=lambda_sep diagonal define local approximate symmetry locus (OP-OMS-017).

B.name: B: Closure-Boundary Swap
B.note: Scene/lambda-dependent. frac_asym=0.500: exactly half asymmetric. NOT a global gauge symmetry. Partial behavior may reflect regime-specific approximate symmetry.

C.name: C: Boundary-Closure Compensation
C.description: lambda_cl += delta, lambda_bd -= delta, delta in {0.05,0.10,0.15}
C.note: NOT a global symmetry. Near-sym cases near lambda_bd-dominant corner. Consistent with approximate local symmetry near F_bd face.

D.name: D: Boundary-Separation Compensation
D.description: lambda_sep += delta, lambda_bd -= delta, delta in {0.05,0.10,0.15}
D.note: NOT a global symmetry. Same pattern as C near lambda_bd corner.

E.name: E: Transport Ablation (Static Scene)
E.description: lambda_tr -> 0, rescale others proportionally to Δ³
E.note: Prop CW2 COMPUTATIONALLY CONFIRMED. delta_d=delta_T=0.000 for ALL 18 tested pairs on static scenes. Transport weight lambda_tr is gauge-irrelevant for static single-frame observations.

F.name: F: Radial Toward Centroid
F.note: NOT a global gauge direction. 30% of pairs show asymmetry; 70% show approximate invariance (within-basin flatness at small t).

G.name: G: Random Tangent Perturbation
G.description: lambda -> proj_Δ³(lambda + 0.08*v), v random unit tangent
G.note: NOT a global gauge symmetry (21.7% asymmetric). Majority of non-asymmetric cases reflect within-basin flatness at eps=0.08 scale, not gauge invariance.
